records.name: codegraph-first-navigation
records.description: Use CodeGraph before grep when a repository has a .codegraph index
records.body: When a repository contains a .codegraph directory, ask CodeGraph for symbol and call-path context before falling back to grep or direct file reads.

records.name: github-token-hygiene
records.description: Prefer stored GitHub CLI credentials over inherited token environment variables
records.body: On selamy-core, run gh commands with GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN unset so a stale inherited token does not mask the valid stored CLI session.

records.name: nash-open-loop-theater
records.description: Nash changes must close the loop against Ready and trading state
records.body: Open-loop PR and CI motion is not enough for Nash. Require live-overlay render checks, Argo convergence alarms, outcome probes, and trading-latch registry enforcement before claiming progress.

records.name: arc-runner-pending-attribution
records.description: Speedforge queue latency needs ARC status attribution before source patches
records.body: Runner queue pressure should be attributed with AutoScalingRunnerSet pendingEphemeralRunners, currentRunners, runningEphemeralRunners, minRunners, and maxRunners before changing thresholds.

cases.query: Should I use CodeGraph before grep in indexed repositories?
How do we avoid Nash productivity theater around trading readiness?
